object.name: TonWalletTransfer
object.description: Describes a service message about a transfer with a TON wallet.
object.html_description: Describes a service message about a transfer with a TON wallet.
object.rst_description: Describes a service message about a transfer with a TON wallet.

annotations.description: Unique identifier of the transaction; may be empty if the transfer hasn't been sent yet
annotations.html_description: Unique identifier of the transaction; may be empty if the transfer hasn't been sent yet
annotations.rst_description: Unique identifier of the transaction; may be empty if the transfer hasn't been sent yet
annotations.name: transaction_id

annotations.description: Address of the transfer peer in the TON blockchain
annotations.html_description: Address of the transfer peer in the TON blockchain
annotations.rst_description: Address of the transfer peer in the TON blockchain
annotations.name: peer_address

annotations.description: The amount of transferred cryptocurrency, in the smallest units of the cryptocurrency, as a decimal number; negative for outgoing transfers
annotations.html_description: The amount of transferred cryptocurrency, in the smallest units of the cryptocurrency, as a decimal number; negative for outgoing transfers
annotations.rst_description: The amount of transferred cryptocurrency, in the *smallest units* of the cryptocurrency, as a decimal number; negative for outgoing transfers
annotations.name: amount

annotations.description: Comment added to the transfer; omitted if the comment is encrypted
annotations.html_description: Optional. Comment added to the transfer; omitted if the comment is encrypted
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Comment added to the transfer; omitted if the comment is encrypted
annotations.name: comment
